nina: Heads-up — publishing community-integration-templates v0.1.0 :tada:

nina: Repo + release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-integration-templates/releases/tag/v0.1.0

nina: Short summary: 4 lightweight templates to speed up integrations:
- webhook-ingest (Fast webhook -> normalized events)
- sync-embeddings (periodic sync into vector DB)
- auth-proxy (example middleware for RBAC + API keys)
- telemetry-hook (structured event schema + batching)

tom: Nice! who owns the auth-proxy template for maintenance?

nina: @tom will be primary maintainer for auth-proxy. I'll list owners in the CODEOWNERS file.

eva: added a small Contributing guide and a checklist for security review. Important: do not ship test secrets (callout in README).

ci-bot: CI: quick checks passed (lint + unit smoke). Scheduled full run tonight. :white_check_mark:

dev-bot: Docker image built: redwood/integration-templates:v0.1.0

nina: Minimal example for webhook-ingest (put in README):
```json
{
  "url": "https://hooks.example.com/ingest",
  "headers": {"Authorization":"Bearer $INTEGRATION_KEY"}
}
```

tom: I'll open an issues template for support requests and a roadmap note for v0.2 (obs: multi-tenant patterns).

eva: scheduling a 30-min drop-in tomorrow 11am PT for community contributors who want to help triage. Reply here to join.

nina: thanks all — feel free to star the repo and share feedback. :sparkles:
